places.name: Floating Garden
places.public_description: The planted beds glow green. Across the canal Mara waits, unaware whether the planting succeeded.

commitments: Bring the tin to the floating garden.

recent_events: Mara smiles. “Would you take these seeds across? Ring the bell and the ferry will come.” She holds the tin out, waiting for your answer.
The tin is pleasantly warm in your hands. One bell-note sends ripples through the canal. A little rope-guided ferry bumps the quay.
“Keep them dry until they touch the silver mulch,” Mara says. “They drink starlight, not canal water.” She points toward the garden beds.
You ferry the tin across without a splash. Beneath the silver mulch the seeds kindle into green stars. Mara remains a small silhouette on the opposite bank.
Mara lets out a relieved breath. “Then the garden will make it through the night.” Beyond her shoulder the floating beds shine like a little constellation.

laws: The brass bell calls one ferry.
world.premise: A floating garden needs its dusk courier.
world.title: The Seed Ferry
